== Acquisition ==
This skill is available while under the [[Going Commando]] disguise during the [[April Fools' Day]] quest [[Annihilator]].

== Related skills ==
*{{skill icon|Shockwave}} ([[elite]])

== Notes ==
* Similar to [[shout]]s, characters will say ''"Grenade!"'' when this skill is activated.
* Damage is dealt as [[packet]]s of 100. Adjacent foes will be hit three times, nearby foes will be hit twice, and foes in the area will only be hit once.
{{anomaly|The descriptions omit that this is a [[projectile spell]].}}
